item.title: The fastest-growing Ebola outbreak ever
item.description: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo crossed a grim threshold over the weekend. The World Health Organization said on Saturday the outbreak reached 3,605 cases, making it the DRC’s largest Ebola outbreak ever. Less than three months in, it is also the fastest-growing outbreak in the history of the virus. item.title: IDF reservist indicted over stolen IDF rifle, drug ring that supplied soldiers
item.description: What began as an investigation into a stolen M16 evolved into a wider probe that uncovered an alleged drug trafficking network and implicated an IDF officer. A reservist and a civilian were indicted on Monday over the theft and alleged trafficking of an M16 rifle taken from an IDF base in northern Israel, Israel Police and the military said in a joint statement.

item.title: Death toll rises from Ceuta migrant surge
item.description: More than 60,000 people on Friday crossed into the small Spanish territory in a chaotic rush that overwhelmed local authorities. Many of the victims drowned while attempting to swim around border barriers and breakwaters separating Ceuta from Morocco. While most migrants have since returned to Morocco, the tragedy has intensified pressure on Spain and the EU to prevent similar humanitarian disasters in the future.

item.title: Young Danes start extended military service
item.description: Some 1,600 young Danes began their military service on Monday for 11 months -- a nearly three-fold increase in duration -- as a consequence of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.Denmark, a NATO member state, decided in 2024 to extend the length of its military service from four months and to open it up to women.

item.title: Large forest fire breaks out in the Netherlands
item.description: A fire has broken out in a wooded area in the east of the Netherlands, not far from the German border, emergency services said on Monday. Firefighters have been deployed to the De Rosmolen nature reserve near the village of Oostrum to tackle the blaze and prevent it from spreading further, it said.

item.title: Delay saved DHL cargo plane from mid-air fire, court witness says
item.description: Testimony during a trial in Lithuania of five people suspected of mailing incendiary devices has shown how narrowly a cargo plane avoided being set on fire in mid-flight in July 2024. A DHL company representative said on the witness stand that the parcel caught fire on the ground at DHL's logistics centre at the airport in the German city of Leipzig shortly before loading, rather than during the flight, because the plane was delayed.
